basis: Epibulbar lipodermoids and preauricular skin appendages define the syndrome; accessory nipples have no axis.
Epithelial tumor arising in the renal cortex; no common extrarenal involvement.
Mitochondrial encephalomyopathy with persistent lactic acidosis, brain injury and muscle involvement; isolated small-sample findings do not establish other common organ damage.
Hereditary localized loss of hair pigmentation; hair belongs to the dermatologic axis.
Clonal expansion of hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells; subsequent malignancy and cardiovascular disease are risks.
Odontogenic epithelial tumor arising in and occupying jaw bone; dental origin and intraosseous location support both axes.
Major origins are oral and salivary tissues and the upper respiratory tract; rare ocular and external-ear subtypes do not characterize the umbrella.
Storage encephalopathy; hepatosplenomegaly (2/2) lacks demonstrated dysfunction; respiratory failure may be neurologic; optic atrophy occurs in 5-29%.
Severe cardiac pump failure; oliguria, hypoxemia and reduced consciousness do not establish additional lasting organ damage.
Benign tumor of the rete ovarii, a reproductive structure; no endocrine activity or other qualifying organ involvement.
Lymphoid-cell malignancy arising in the CNS; lymphoma requires the infectious_immune mechanism axis.
Purely psychiatric paraphilic disorder without defining damage to a covered organ.
Nonsyndromic congenital fusion of digits; no established extraskeletal organ disease.
Developmental/intellectual impairment follows the syndromic parent; cardiac, thymic and parathyroid abnormalities vary and lack reliable frequency evidence here.
Mild branched-chain amino acid metabolic disorder; supplied findings establish aminoacidemia without common neurologic injury.
Inherited disorders defined by persistent erythematous hyperkeratotic skin plaques; systemic findings belong to particular subtypes.
Sheldon-Hall distal arthrogryposis with congenital hand and foot contractures; facial appearance alone does not establish other organ damage.
Congenital cystic malformation of pulmonary airways; associated malformations are not established as common involvement of another axis.
Microcephaly and motor delay occur in 30-79%; cardiac, ocular, limb and gastrointestinal malformations are individually reported in 5-29%.
Functional gastric disorder defined by impaired digestion and upper gastrointestinal discomfort; underlying causes are separate conditions.
Limb absence and lung agenesis (5/7) characterize this subtype; gastrointestinal involvement includes cleft palate in 6/7 and cleft lip in 4/7.
Neurodevelopmental disease with persistent gastrointestinal dysmotility in 80-99%; eye movement signs are neurologic; adrenal synonyms conflict with the definition.
Nephrotic syndrome and microcephaly occur in 4/4; developmental delay in 3/4; skin changes are below 30% and visual involvement is unquantified.
Pericardial fluid or blood compresses the heart and impairs filling; no additional organ is intrinsically defined by the condition.
Defined neuro-ophthalmological syndrome with cerebellar malformations and cognitive impairment; amblyopia, myopia and retinal atrophy occur in 30-79%.
